description: This Java class 'RecurringDepositImportHandler' handles importing recurring deposit account data from Excel files into a system, processing various steps such as reading, validation, importing data, and managing related commands in a banking or financial application.

classes.name: RecurringDepositImportHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles importing recurring deposit account data from Excel sheets, including reading, processing, and executing commands to set up deposit accounts in the system.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main entry method that reads the Excel Workbook and initiates the import process, returning a count of successes and errors.

methods.name: readExcelFile
methods.description: Reads data from the specified sheet in the workbook and populates lists of deposit data, approval, and activation dates.

methods.name: readSavingsActivation
methods.description: Creates a SavingsActivation object from a row if an activation date is present.

methods.name: readSavingsApproval
methods.description: Creates a SavingsApproval object from a row if an approval date is present.

methods.name: readSavings
methods.description: Reads all relevant fields from a row to construct a RecurringDepositAccountData object, parsing various deposit parameters and charges.

methods.name: importEntity
methods.description: Processes the list of deposit data, performing creation, approval, and activation steps, and updates the Excel sheet with status reports.

methods.name: writeRecurringDepositErrorMessage
methods.description: Writes error messages to the Excel sheet for failed import steps, setting appropriate status and error report.

methods.name: setReportHeaders
methods.description: Sets the header titles for the status and error columns in the sheet.

methods.name: importSavingsActivation
methods.description: Issues commands to activate a recurring deposit account if an activation date is present.

methods.name: importSavingsApproval
methods.description: Issues commands to approve a recurring deposit account if an approval date is provided.

methods.name: importSavings
methods.description: Builds and submits a command to create a new recurring deposit account in the system.

methods.name: getProgressLevel
methods.description: Determines the current processing step status based on the account's status field.
